title: Proportional overshadowing limit where the affected lot's northern boundary is shared with other lots (A3.2.3 footnote 1)
text: Where a development site shares its southern boundary with a lot, and that lot is bound to the north by other lot(s), the limit of shading at A 3.2.3 shall be reduced proportionally to the percentage of the affected properties northern boundary that abuts the development site.

replaces.note: Appendix A7 explanatory figure not carried into the draft

notes: from: ch4p1 C3.8.3. Applicant states that the shadow is within the A3.2.3 limit scaled by the share of the affected lot's northern boundary that abuts the site; not computed. The supporting figure (Vol 2 Figure A7.2) is deleted, so the method of proportioning is not illustrated. Moot where the adjoining lot is coded R80 or higher (nil requirement).

verified.note: p28 footnote 1 says the limit is 'reduced proportionally' but gives no method or figure for the proportioning (Vol 2 Figure A7.2 deleted).
